question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

(13, 224, 15)
solution:
**Logic : (First number × Third number) + (First number + Third number + 1) = Second number **

**Given : (13, 224, 15) **

(13 × 15) + (13 + 15 + 1) = 224

195 + 29 = 224

224 = 224 (LHS = RHS)

So,

 
• (9, 108, 12)

​(9 × 12) + (9 + 12 + 1) = 108
